<thought>The spectrum shows a clear +2 Da isotopic series (231.97 → 233.96 → 235.96 → …) with intensity ratios roughly 3:1, which is characteristic of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). It also shows a +1 Da series (231.97 → 232.97 → 233.96 → …) indicating the presence of carbon (13C) isotopes. No other distinct isotopic patterns (e.g., Br’s ~1:1 M/M+2 or S’s multiple small peaks) are evident. Therefore the definitively identifiable elements are chlorine and carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl', 'C']</final_answer>
